lines.t: I arrived at Sky Lantern Street, where I'd agreed to meet Dan Xi.
Sky Lantern Street
And there stood Dan Xi, naked.
Hmm, my friend is late.
Oh! My friend! Over here, over here!
I believe you have the wrong person.
Hm!? What are you saying, my friend! Have you forgotten me?
Amnesia? Or have your eyes failed you? I happen to know a skilled physician, so...
No, my memory's fine and my eyes work great. It's just...
There's no way I know someone standing around <bouten>stark naked</bouten> on a main street in broad daylight!
What!? Stark naked...?
Look wherever you like, there isn't a naked soul in sight, though?
I mean you! You!
How rude of you, my friend. Am I not properly dressed?
How on earth
can you call that
being dressed!!
Good grief. You're always going on about breasts this and rear ends that, yet you make a fuss over a little thing like this.
Look, of course I'm into this stuff, too, but... when you're this brazen about it, it kills half the fun.
Isn't embarrassment supposed to be the whole point of exhibitionism??
Oho!
Then would it suffice if I went, "Ahn♡ I'm so embarrassed♡" for you?
...Like you're even the type to get embarrassed over that in the first place.
Haha! True enough, indeed.
*Sigh*... Anyway, what's going on?
And what's with that outfit today...?
This? Hmm... It's a rather long story to explain...
Keep it short and sweet. Give me the three-line summary.
My friend truly does love a good summary.
Hehe, well then, as for how things came to this...
Once upon a time... there lived a little girl.
Cut the crap. It wasn't "once upon a time," and you're no little girl.
Hmph, can you not simply listen quietly? Old tales always come with a touch of embellishment.
People usually call that glorifying the past. Actually, isn't that less glorifying and more straight-up fiction?
...If you do not wish to hear it, I shan't tell you!
...Go on.
In any case... swept up in the spirit of the Halloween festival, the little girl wandered into an inn.
(Drunk on booze, more like, not the festival spirit.)
No interrupting even in your thoughts.
Ahem!
Aw, screw it, this is taking too long—just sum it up in one line!
Goodness, what an impatient fellow. Very well. I shall sum it up in a single line for you!
And so, without thinking, the little girl drank up all the Halloween offering Requiem Wine sitting in the inn! The end!
...Requiem Wine? "Without thinking"?
Indeed! Who could have imagined that such fragrant liquor sitting right out in the open at an inn was meant as a sacred offering...?
So it definitely wasn't "without thinking." Wait, shouldn't you know better than to drink booze you didn't even buy in the first place?
I thought the very same thing! Which is why I intended to wet only the tip of my tongue and leave it at that.
However...
Lifting one cup, its fragrance graced my nose.
Tilting another, its rich flavor danced upon my tongue.
Downing a third, it felt as though it washed right through my very chest...
How could anyone possibly stop the cup after that?
Yeah, yeah, spoken like a true alcoholic!
How heartless! My friend, you appreciate fine liquor yourself—how can you not understand this feeling?
Because I'm not a hopeless lush who'd die for a drink.
Well, whatever. I get the picture. So basically...
You drank the booze sitting in the inn, got completely plastered, and ended up stark naked, right?
Hm? What do you mean? I never said a word about taking off my clothes, did I?
...? Then what gives? Why on earth are you dressed like that?
Hmm. Well, after that, the children of the clan showed up...
Making a grand fuss that the liquor I drank was meant to purify a whole year's worth of accumulated Corrupting Power...
And claiming that without that liquor, the Corrupting Power would run wild and throw Quartet into utter chaos...
So I told them, "Since I already drank the liquor, why don't I just take that in right along with it!"
How is that supposed to be a solution...?
Ahn♡! My friend, when you look at me with eyes like that... Haa...♡ It makes me feel rather strange...♡
In any event... since the liquor is already inside this body of mine, why not simply put the Corrupting Power inside me as well?
These talismans are the result of that, so to speak.
So... right now, you've got both the booze and the Corrupting Power inside your body?
Correct! Hehe, perhaps I ought to give you a prize?
Yeah, no, I have a bad feeling about getting dragged into this, so I'm just gonna head back.
Come now, don't be like that.
Since you've come all this way, shouldn't you join me in enjoying the festivities? Otherwise, my trouble in slipping past the watch would all be for naught.
Slipping past the what?
The watch, I say. Those Umbral Watch folks made such a fuss telling me to stay put and behave...
Honestly, I kept telling them I can easily dissolve a bit of Corrupting Power on my own, so it's perfectly fine!
No, no, when experts give you a prescription, you're supposed to follow it quietly.
Are you telling me you ignored everything they said and snuck out!?
Come now, it is fine. In my experience, a trifle like this is—
...Found you.
A ninja's here—!
I am not a ninja. I am a kunoichi.
Same difference...
Oh my, you've caught up already? Truly worthy of a first-rate kunoichi of the Umbral Watch.
Flattery will not make me go easy on you. None can escape the eyes of the Umbral Watch.
For the record, Lady Dan Xi slipping past our watch was also part of my plan.
Is that so? Then... you must have also planned for how I will respond next!

Of course. Let's see... Based on Lady Dan Xi's personality, there are twelve possible action patterns you might take in this situation... five ways I can counter them... and from there... *mumble, mumble*...
...Now is our chance, my friend!
Huh!? Running away again right here...?
...B-But that is also within my calculations!!

lines.t: I arrived at Sky Lantern Street, which was bustling with preparations for the Halloween festival.
Sky Lantern Street
Oh, my friend!
And there stood nudity incarnate.
Not that I'm complaining, Quartet, but are you sure this is okay...?
Hm? What do you mean?
Just worrying about public morals in Quartet.
Haha, what is there to worry about? Everyone here is so stiff and proper all the time.
If you ask me, it wouldn't hurt for people to be a bit more open-minded.
Open-minded...?
How much more "open" are you trying to get from here?
Hmm? Why, do you wish to see me get even more open than this?
Obviously!
Goodness me. You truly are hopeless♡
Wait, stop! I'd love that, but I don't want to get arrested here!
I already got arrested for public indecency by total accident back in Humanitas...
Oho? And what would be so bad about that?
I'll pass on going through that again. Besides, I doubt this place has a luxury facility like Panoticon...
Hmm... A pity, then. I wouldn't mind being arrested alongside my friend.
Save the crime thriller talk and just tell me why you called me out here already.
Hm? Why I called you?
Are you really gonna play dumb now? You took a hostage, remember?
Aaah!! R-Right, of course. I took a hostage!
That sounded mighty suspicious... The hostage is safe, right?
Hehe, of course, of course. Its flavor and aroma are completely intact. Though there is one minor issue...
A minor... issue? Don't tell me you drank it all?
...Honestly, I left plenty for you and me to drink our fill, so fret not.
It is just that there are a few matters we must settle before we can share a cup.
Not like I expected you to call me out here without putting me to work anyway.
Honestly, my friend! Just what do you take me for?
...A walking disaster?
Well, I admit I do tend to cause my fair share of trouble, but...
A-Ahem! Really now, putting it so bluntly leaves me with no dignity at all. Couldn't you phrase it a little more gently...?
That was me phrasing it gently, so hurry up and tell me what we need to do.
Keep stalling and I'm gonna peel those talismans right off your body.
What an outrageous fellow. In all of Quartet, you are likely the only one who would dare treat me so.
In any case, as for what the matter is...
In any case, Lady Dan Xi acting this way was also part of my plan.
She claims literally everything is part of her plan.
Hehe, do you not find that side of her rather cute?
Well, I won't deny that.
So rather than trying to lock Lady Dan Xi up when she would inevitably slip past our watch anyway, I judged it best to keep her under our direct supervision...
...And so I hid the remaining Requiem Wine that Lady Dan Xi didn't finish in a secret location.
What?! My booze!
Nay, my friend. "Our" booze, is it not?
Wait, your hostage got taken hostage? And you still called me out here like that?
If you want the liquor back... you will have to help with the festival preparations.
By having Lady Dan Xi—who drank the Requiem Wine—walk around the grounds, we can purify the Corrupting Power that the Requiem Wine was originally meant to cleanse.
Furthermore, it doubles as the disciplinary service the clan ordered for Lady Dan Xi, killing three birds with one stone... A flawless plan.
...And so, we now march forth to rescue our hostage!
Where do I report fraud around here? The Moonshadow Wardens? Or is there a direct line to The Four Seasons?
D-Doing that would blow this whole matter out of proportion, so please hold back!?
Ahem, ahem! My apologies, my friend. However, my promise still stands, and my word is good...
Help me with the festival preparations! Do that, and we shall share that delicious liquor together, shall we not?!
Wow... How can you say that without batting an eye...?
This is way too steep a price just to get baited by a drink...
And that's how I ended up helping Dan Xi prepare for the festival, except...
Over here! If anyone has a free hand, help me out! We need to put up this stall!
Oho, in need of assistance, are you? Wait just a moment!
Ah! You're... Lady Dan Xi!? Wait—
Oh dear! It snapped right in two. What a fragile pillar, breaking from such a light touch.
M-My stall...!
Hold on, stay calm. Only one pillar's gone down so far.
We still have three pillars left...
Oh my! Are all pillars made this flimsy nowadays?
I'm ruined before I could even open for business...!
...It's fine, the Umbral Watch plans on covering all the damages anyway.
Oh, really? That might actually work out then! Think I can lump in all the merchandise I was gonna sell onto the claim too?
Hmm... How troublesome. Had Sirius been here, I could have left this to her.
Come to think of it, where did Sirius go?
The clan folks sealed her away right along with me. Telling me, "Please do some work yourself once in a while"...
Well, I suppose it makes for a rare break for Sirius. She is usually kept quite busy running my little errands.
...Just what kind of battles have you been fighting all this time, Master Sirius...?
Anyway, looks like we're done here, so let's move on.
Aaagh! We're opening any minute now and I still haven't finished prepping the ingredients! Somebody help!
Hmm. It seems my aid is needed! I cannot simply stand idly by!
Ah! Lady Dan Xi!? Wait a second!
...I'm getting serious déjà vu here.
Alright, we destroy the festival, which is the root of the problem. Operation's going smoothly.
We had such an operation?
Of course not! What are you, a walking wrecking ball? You break everything you touch!
You were clumsy before, sure, but never this bad... Wait, is it because of that seal?
Aye. The spell is meant to hold the Corrupting Power within my body to purify it... yet because of that, I can hardly keep my own strength in check.
Is that thing even safe? It's not contagious, right?
What do you take this for, a common cold?
You need not worry. It is impossible for Corrupting Power to corrupt this body of mine.
Even so... this is quite a predicament. To think I can neither enjoy the festival nor lend a proper hand like this.
What, getting cold feet? That's not like you.
Seals, Corrupting Power—I don't really care about minor details like that.
Rolling over and surrendering after failing twice just because of a little penalty like that?
What happened to that grit of yours? You kept coming back for more, even when the odds were against you and you were getting crushed!
...R-Rolling over and surrendering...
He, hehe... Hahaha...!
Is that how it looked to you?
Truly, you are my friend. You certainly know just how to push my buttons.
Only because you're such an easy mark to begin with.
You speak the truth. Cowering after a mere two blunders simply will not do.
In that case... my friend. Will you humor me once more?
Obviously. I haven't even had a single sip of that booze yet.

The more I try to help, the more I break... What a dilemma!
I can't keep going like this, but I can't just give up.

If this keeps up, I'll be no help at all, and we won't get our liquor back...
How am I supposed to keep my promise then?
There is one way.

You mean it?
For real. Though it comes with a price...
My friend, do I look like someone who fears paying a price?
Stop teasing and spit it out already—can you not see I am burning with impatience?

All right, then...
Here's what we can do.
The reason you can't control your strength is because of that seal, right?

So...
I met up with Kage yesterday and got the manual for your talismans.
It said something or other about the Blissful Trading Guild on it, though...

A manual for the talismans?
What do you mean, "something or other"?
Ah, never mind the minor details—I'm talking about those things stuck to your body...
From what I read, you can actually adjust the output on those talismans stuck to you.
If we tune the talismans' power, your strength won't go haywire and you'll stop accidentally smashing everything, right?
Ooh! I didn't know that was possible!

There's just one catch...
It comes with a little side effect...

A side effect?
...Please. As if a little side effect could get the better of me.

Well, this one's a little unusual...
Apparently, it makes your whole body several times more sensitive.
Sensitivity across my entire body...!?
Yeah, by about... 30 times, give or take?
Thirty times...!
So if we're not careful, you might literally lose your mind—or climax your brains out in more ways than one.
No, if things go wrong, even the slightest breeze or the brush of a sleeve could...
So, should we do it or not? If you're really scared, we don't have to...
Heh, heh, heh... What a foolish question, my friend.
Do you think I, of all people, would come this far... only to run away!?
Well, I figured you'd say that.
So you're ready for this, right?
There is no need to steel myself to begin with. For I am always ready!
Now then, go ahead and do as you please!!

Try moving that prop on the left.

Surely you are not telling me to just stand by and watch?
Of course not. You're planning to teach them a lesson, right?
Should I not? I must teach them a sharp lesson so they never pull a stunt like that again.

What if I told you there's a much more useful way to teach them a lesson?
